# ArcheAge Chronicles Wiki

> An unofficial player-made guide for ArcheAge Chronicles: the four launch classes, weapon mastery, respec mechanics and the launch-day route — verified against official class introductions and dated.

Wiki for ArcheAge Chronicles (PC (Steam), by XLGames). Articles cover boss guides, tier lists, codes, items, and beginner tips.

## Articles

- [ArcheAge Chronicles Tier List — Best Classes & Weapons (Early Access)](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/archeagechronicles-guide/guides/tier-list/): The community tier consensus for ArcheAge Chronicles Early Access: Axe and Shield tops PvE at 10/10, Hatchet is the best all-rounder at 9.5/9.5, Longsword owns PvP at 10/10, and Warhammer sits last at 5/5 — though its stacking trait was just fixed. Four unreleased weapons are marked projected.
- [ArcheAge Chronicles Known Issues — Launch Bugs, Fixes & Patch Status](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/archeagechronicles-guide/guides/troubleshooting/): The first fix wave is live: the November 4 maintenance deployed the tutorial-progression fix, a Meliot spawn fix, and quest-abandon changes. The generic boss-despawn fix is not yet confirmed shipped, and the Malchuk and party-disband issues remain under investigation. Full status sheet below, dated November 6, 2026.
- [ArcheAge Chronicles Launch-Day Guide — Your First Hours](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/archeagechronicles-guide/guides/beginner-guide/): ArcheAge Chronicles is live in Steam Early Access as of November 3, 2026 (23:16 UTC). This guide covers what to do in your first hours: the install checklist, picking one of the eight launch weapons, swapping with Q, the level-25 build lock, and the launch-week issues to know about — verified in-game and dated.
- [ArcheAge Chronicles Classes & Weapon Mastery Guide (Launch)](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/archeagechronicles-guide/guides/class-guide/): ArcheAge Chronicles launched into Early Access with four classes and eight weapons — two per class. Warrior runs longsword or greatsword, Ranger hatchet or longbow, Mage elemental staff or wavesword, Berserker axe and shield or warhammer. Each weapon has its own skill set and progression, swapping is instant, and gender locks are in place until the December update.
